notes.title: Patch notes - Saturday, November 16, 2024
notes.content:
- Fixed some issues and a visual bug related to game Window/Fullscreen mode



- increased Elmas maxium(blue) level skill effect range, now she has a much wider AOE at maxium level

- increased Arama overall Stamina gain, now she can stay active longer

- increased Moreal count, now she can gain more count from clicking, makes it easier to reach maxium count
